extras.real_size: gift sleigh without animals, approx. 2.3 m long, 1.1 m wide, 1.5 m tall with presents
extras.notes: front (bow) faces -Y; berry red sleigh body with curled bow, gold rim, gold scrolls and a five point star on each side, gold runners with scroll ends and curved struts, bench with green velvet cushion and padded backrest, six wrapped presents (stars, dots, stripes, crossed ribbons, bows, rosette), fir garland with a red bow and berries on the bow, leather straps with gold jingle bells, small lantern on a curved arm with warm light ('sleigh_lantern_glow', emissive, not baked); runners are fixed; no animals, no figure, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
